audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer sells the lane as 'blind his Focused Resolve' — a blind does nothing to an ability-damage enchanter, and the difficulty framing contradicts the mirror.
audit.why: Blinding Assault (Q) blinds basic attacks; Karma's damage is Inner Flame (Q) and Focused Resolve (W). The content layer already says exactly this ('her damage is on abilities, so your blind does nothing').
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty is driven by Inner Flame's 950 range vs your 1025 Q but her 5s rank-5 cooldown, and by Focused Resolve's flat 12s tether. Reworded tldr/winCon accordingly.
sources: kit brief: quinn Q 'hinder its vision'; karma Q/W text

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart read Skill/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Skill/Quinn/Quinn in both layers, contradicting the packet chart, every whys[] entry, and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Mirror (karma__quinn) locked all seven rows to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Quinn, Karma, Karma. whys[0..6] on this side already describe Karma winning every stage except 6.
audit.corrected: All seven rows flipped in matched full/content pairs to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Quinn, Karma, Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions never reach the page: Focused Resolve (W) and Mantra (R) cancel Behind Enemy Lines, and Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma.
audit.why: Quinn's R is flagged 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it'; Karma's W is hardCC and its Mantra bonus heals her. Both listed in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].t/.d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns now state the 12s flat W cooldown, the 675-range tether break, the R-channel cancel, and the Grievous Wounds requirement.

audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at all ranks; Inner Flame drops 9s to 5s.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: Weather the poke — blind his Focused Resolve and kite the all-in apart. Quinn wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — Blinding Assault won't stop her abilities, so dodge Inner Flame and punish Focused Resolve's flat 12s.

edits.before: Blind his Focused Resolve and kite the all-in apart. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Her damage is on abilities, so the blind does little — dodge Inner Flame and Vault in only while Focused Resolve's 12s is down.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A flat 12s tether — break it by leaving 675 range or line of sight. Engage only once it's down.

edits.before: Karma wastes Focused Resolve — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Focused Resolve spent — 12 seconds down, run the full pattern now.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Focused Resolve roots unless you break the 675-range tether, and it cancels Behind Enemy Lines — channel only once her W is spent.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: flat 12s — the tether roots unless you break line of sight or leave 675 range. - Mantra also heals it, so bring Grievous Wounds to extended trades. - Behind Enemy Lines: never channel while W or Mantra is up.
